RAY_MOD_RELIC_MINE_RELIC.title: Descend the Mine
RAY_MOD_RELIC_MINE_RELIC.description:
At the start of each turn, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Depth[/gold].
Higher Depth is stronger, but above 50 you can no longer summon Sand Beasts.
Each time you enter Depth 20-29, gain a potion.

RAY_MOD_RELIC_MINE_RELIC.flavor: The deeper you go, the harder it is to turn back.
RAY_MOD_RELIC_DEEP_MINE_RELIC.title: Deep Mine
RAY_MOD_RELIC_DEEP_MINE_RELIC.descriptio:
At the start of each turn, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Depth[/gold] and draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
Each time you enter Depth 20-29, gain a potion.

RAY_MOD_RELIC_DEEP_MINE_RELIC.flavor: Go deeper still, to where even light cannot reach.
